title: Two Maidens
summary: Two young maidens sat by the fountain. One had dazzling ruby cheeks and sparkling eyes, but spent her hours admiring her reflection in the water and mocking the poor....
full_text:
Two young maidens sat by the fountain. One had dazzling ruby cheeks and sparkling eyes, but spent her hours admiring her reflection in the water and mocking the poor.

The other had pale, modest features, but spent her days tending the sick, weaving clothes for orphans, and speaking with tender kindness.

When the prince rode by, the proud beauty threw herself into his path, but her harsh laughter and vanity chilled his heart. He turned to the quiet maiden whose gentle eyes reflected the pure sky, and made her his queen.
moral: Outward cosmetics fade with the morning dew; the gentle fragrance of inner virtue endures forever.
